source: Sleeper league API scoring_settings and roster_positions, read 2026-10-20

projection_coverage.pf: estimated at 0.08 per projected minute (labelled assumption)
projection_coverage.threshold_bonuses: bonus_pt_40p, bonus_pt_50p, bonus_reb_20p and bonus_ast_15p are not projected; counted as 0
projection_coverage.dd_td: projected per-game rates averaged into every game; a passable-outcome model was backtested and reverted

evidence_limitations: Backtested on real 2025-26 games with 2024-25 forecasts and no waivers; see studies/eight-team-backtest/2026-10-19-league-scoring.
In that backtest the injury-aware advisor trailed ADP drafting by 146 +/- 39 weekly points in an ADP room and tied (+14 +/- 35) in a scoring-aware room.
Rankings use Sleeper 2026 season projections with default game-count, variance and availability assumptions.
